All three net balances match the order totals minus the refunds in the ledger, and the refunds match Alpha's handoff, so I see no reason to hold. Recording acme's payout of 62169 first.
Acme's payout is recorded. Birch's net of 48740 matches its orders (29142 + 20980) minus refund 274 (1382), so I'll record that payout next.
Cobalt's net of 15791 matches its orders (21885 + 13448) minus refunds 272 (17238) and 275 (2304). Everything checks out, so I'll record the last payout.
All three payouts are recorded. Each net balance matches its orders minus the refunds in the ledger, and the refunds match Alpha's handoff.
